description:
Venta R is all-rounder performance road bike with modern lines and innovative features, created to inspire riders to engage with cycling, making premium and technological bikes accessible.

Venta R is our all-rounder performance road bike with modern lines and innovative features, created to inspire riders to engage with cycling, making premium and technological bikes accessible. A bike that not only serves practical cycling ventures but also, connects with others with performance and style.

Featuring aero-shaped tubes with a thoughtful balance that avoids extremes, the Venta R ensures agile handling in all riding scenarios, including challenging conditions like high winds.

Its carefully crafted cut-out for the rear wheel paired with lowered seat stays, enhances aerodynamics, reducing drag and maximizing speed.

Complementing this design, the straight-bladed fork delivers precise handling and responsive control, making every ride a thrilling and effortless experience.

For the latest iteration of Venta R , we based the frame on Torayca T700 carbon fibers for both frame and fork paired with in mold bearing housing with no additional inserts. This allows us to create a light and durable bike to enhance maneuverability making it easier for riders to handle across all frame sizes.

Shimano 105, 12-speed, mechanical or electronic. A wide gear range and refined ergonomics make shifting second nature, so you can focus on the road ahead and let technology elevate every ride.

Choose between Microtech Omnia alloy wheels and Gregale c arbon wheels, both featuring a 25mm internal rim width and CNC-machined hubs for lasting durability and performance.

A totally hidden fixing solution that is invisible on the frame, intertwining technological and aesthetic innovation. The result is a lightweight, invisible and strong integrated system, which has been further implemented through the vulcanization of the steel plank. This Basso solution gives the 3B system an anti-vibration function, which improves the riding experience by elevating comfort on uneven and bumpy surfaces.

The seatpost seamlessly integrates with the frame and seatpost clamp, ensuring optimal comfort and performance. The bike comes equipped with a 15 mm setback Heart Carbon seatpost from Basso, with an additional 0 mm option available for purchase separately.

Venta R pairs the new Stato Stem with Microtech’s Integrated Cables Headset, semi-integrating mechanical and electronic groupsets while keeping the stem cable-free and effortless to adjust, without compromising precise handling.
